description: Source code for NVTX observer in PyTorch profiler, implementing thread-local state management, tensor input/output tracking, and callback registration for NVTX profiling.

classes.name: NVTXThreadLocalState
classes.description: Thread-local state management for NVTX profiling, including tensor-to-op mapping and profiler configuration validation.

methods.name: getOpIdFromInput
methods.description: Retrieves the operation ID associated with a given tensor.

methods.name: setProducerTensorMap
methods.description: Associates a tensor with an operation ID and output number.

methods.name: getTLS
methods.description: Gets the thread-local NVTX profiling state.

methods.name: flattenOpIdList
methods.description: Flattens a list of IValues into a list of operation ID pairs.

methods.name: getInputTensorOpIds
methods.description: Extracts operation IDs from the inputs of a RecordFunction.

methods.name: updateOutputTensorTracker
methods.description: Updates the mapping of output tensors to their producer operation IDs.

methods.name: enterNVTX
methods.description: Creates an observer context for NVTX profiling, optionally reporting input shapes.

methods.name: pushNVTXCallbacks
methods.description: Registers NVTX profiling callbacks based on the provided configuration and scopes.
